lastCompletedStory.title: WARNING: The US-R6-002 fd-leak fix (`closeSync(logFd)` after Bun.spawn) ships w…

nextStoryContext: US-R8-002 closed the falsifiability gap the round-8 review flagged in src/commands/sidecar-liveness-watch.ts:149: the US-R6-002 closeSync(logFd) fix had no test asserting the PARENT process's own descriptor table -- the only test constructing the production closure (test/integration/stop-defaultlistprocesses-real.test.ts:204-219) only proves the CHILD is discoverable via ps+lsof and gets SIGTERM'd, which holds identically whether or not the parent closes its own fd copy. New file test/integration/sidecar-liveness-watch-fd-leak.test.ts calls the real exported makeSpawnSidecarFn(cwd, argvOverride) 3 times in a loop and asserts via `lsof -p <own pid>` (the CALLING process's own pid, not any child's) that the parent's own open-fd count on .claude/cam-supervisor.log never grows across repeated respawns. Verified falsifiable, not just by inspection: swept red-against-main by temporarily deleting the `closeSync(logFd)` line in sidecar-liveness-watch.ts (test failed: `Expected: 0, Received: 3` -- exactly the 3 respawns leaking one fd each), then restored the fix and reran green; `git diff --stat` after restoring confirmed the source file is byte-identical to before the sweep (no accidental leftover edit). Test skips cleanly via `test.skipIf(!lsofAvailable)`, mirroring the existing skip-gate convention in test/helpers/test-deps.ts (lsof legitimate-environmental in the oven/bun worker container). No production code changed in this story -- purely additive test coverage for an already-shipped fix. Ran the full `bun run check:all` spine (test: 5936 pass / 0 fail, up from 5935 -- exactly +1 new test, 0 regressions; embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all green); no file-size or coverage budget edits were needed (new file has no prior ceiling entry, and the diff only adds coverage). Appended a patterns.md bullet (dated 2026-08-02, US-R8-002) generalizing the lesson: a test proving the CHILD side of a self-spawn's fd contract (holdsSidecarLogOpen / process-identity check) does NOT also prove the PARENT side is leak-free -- the two are orthogonal properties of the same `Bun.spawn({ stdio: [..., number, number] })` call and need independent assertions, for whichever future story reviews another 'parent self-spawns and holds a raw fd' fix. scripts/cam/prd.json still has US-R8-003 (passes:false) queued as a sibling round-8 review finding: patterns.md states the isSidecarArgv contract twice with one dangling cross-reference -- candidate for the next dispatch; out of scope for this story per Surgical Changes.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Bun.spawnSync's SyncSubprocess.stdout is typed `Buffer | undefined` (not ReadableStream, which is the async Bun.spawn shape) -- the test's `result.stdout instanceof Buffer ? result.stdout.toString('utf8') : ''` guard matches the documented shape and mirrors the existing Buffer.from(...)/instanceof Buffer convention already used at src/retry/launcher.ts:84 and multiple src/commands/sidecar.ts call sites.
